verdict.rationale: Together's docs cover the full fine-tune-to-serve lifecycle on one platform. They describe LoRA and full fine-tuning on your own data, jobs launched via console, API/SDK or CLI, and "full lifecycle: data upload, training, hosting, and inference on a dedicated endpoint." Dedicated endpoints explicitly support deploying a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tune-then-deploy workflow (all evidence is vendor docs).
